steps.name: 상태 표시줄 - B2:B5 를 고르면 평균·개수·합계, 누르면 최소·최대
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x; X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:1,r2:4,c2:1}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80)); const b=document.querySelector('#sumBar'); const t1=b.textContent; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); const t2=b.textContent; b.click(); return !b.hidden && t1.includes('합계 2,800') && t1.includes('평균 700') && t1.includes('개수 4') && t2.includes('최대 1,200') ? true : JSON.stringify({t1,t2})

steps.name: 자동 합계(Alt+=) - B6 에서 =SUM(B2:B5) 를 넣고 Enter → 2800
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, ed=X.ED(); X.selectCell(5,1); ed.focus(); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'=',code:'Equal',altKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const v=ed.value; ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,120)); const c=window.NexaSheet.S.deck.sheets[0].cells.B6; return v==='=SUM(B2:B5)' && c && c.f==='=SUM(B2:B5)' && c.v===2800 ? true : JSON.stringify({v,c})

steps.name: 정렬 - B 열 내림차순(첫 줄 머리글 자동), 수식 칸은 범위 밖이라 그대로
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x; X.selectRange({r1:0,c1:0,r2:4,c2:1}); window.NexaSheet.S.cur={r:0,c:1}; window.NexaSheetX.sortRange(true); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,120)); const c=window.NexaSheet.S.deck.sheets[0].cells, v=(k)=>c[k]&&typeof c[k]==='object'?c[k].v:c[k]; return v('A1')==='지역' && v('A2')==='서울' && v('A5')==='광주' && v('B5')===300 ? (window.NexaSheetX.sortRange(false), await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)), v('A2')==='광주' && v('B2')===300 ? true : 'asc '+v('A2')) : JSON.stringify({A1:v('A1'),A2:v('A2'),A5:v('A5')})

steps.name: Ctrl+D - C2:C4 에서 첫 칸(C2) 을 아래로 · 편집 중 Ctrl+Enter 는 고른 범위 모두에
steps.js: const N=window.NexaSheet, X=N.x, ed=X.ED(), sh=()=>N.S.deck.sheets[0]; N.setInput(sh(),'C2','=B2*2'); X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:2,r2:3,c2:2}); ed.focus(); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'d',ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const f3=sh().cells.C3&&sh().cells.C3.f, f4=sh().cells.C4&&sh().cells.C4.f; X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:4,r2:3,c2:4}); X.startEdit('enter','확인'); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const c=sh().cells, v=(k)=>c[k]&&typeof c[k]==='object'?c[k].v:c[k]; return f3==='=B3*2' && f4==='=B4*2' && v('E2')==='확인' && v('E4')==='확인' ? true : JSON.stringify({f3,f4,E2:v('E2'),E4:v('E4')})

steps.name: 찾기·바꾸기 - '지점' → '센터' 모두 바꾸기(2칸), 실행 취소로 되돌림
steps.js: window.NexaSheetX.findBox(true); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); const q=(s)=>document.querySelector(s); q('#fbFind').value='지점'; q('#fbFind').dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); q('#fbRep').value='센터'; q('#fbAll').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const c=window.NexaSheet.S.deck.sheets[0].cells, v=(k)=>c[k]&&typeof c[k]==='object'?c[k].v:c[k]; const ok1=v('D2')==='서울 센터' && v('D3')==='부산 센터' && q('#fbMsg').textContent.includes('2칸'); document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const c2=window.NexaSheet.S.deck.sheets[0].cells; q('#fbClose').click(); return ok1 && (typeof c2.D2==='object'?c2.D2.v:c2.D2)==='서울 지점' ? true : JSON.stringify({D2:v('D2'),msg:q('#fbMsg').textContent})

steps.name: 찾기 - 다음(Enter) 으로 칸을 옮기고 n / m 표시
steps.js: window.NexaSheetX.findBox(false); const q=(s)=>document.querySelector(s); q('#fbFind').value='부산'; q('#fbFind').dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); q('#fbFind').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80)); const nb=q('#nameBox').value, msg=q('#fbMsg').textContent; q('#fbClose').click(); return /^[AD]\d$/.test(nb) && /\d \/ 2/.test(msg) ? true : JSON.stringify({nb,msg})

steps.name: 행·열 숨기기 - 3행·C열을 숨기면 그 머리·칸이 화면에서 빠지고 저장, 숨기기 취소로 되돌림
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, XX=window.NexaSheetX, sh=()=>window.NexaSheet.S.deck.sheets[0]; X.selectRange({r1:2,c1:0,r2:2,c2:0}); XX.hide('r',true); X.selectRange({r1:0,c1:2,r2:0,c2:2}); XX.hide('c',true); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const gone=!document.querySelector('#grid th[data-row="2"]') && !document.querySelector('#grid th[data-col="2"]'); const saved=JSON.stringify([sh().hiddenRows,sh().hiddenCols]); X.selectRange({r1:2,c1:0,r2:2,c2:0}); XX.hide('r',false); X.selectRange({r1:0,c1:2,r2:0,c2:2}); XX.hide('c',false); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const back=!!document.querySelector('#grid th[data-row="2"]') && !sh().hiddenRows && !sh().hiddenCols; return gone && saved==='[["3"],["C"]]' && back ? true : JSON.stringify({gone,saved,back})

steps.name: 필터 - 머리글 ▼ 에서 '부산' 빼기 → 그 행만 가림(저장 안 함), 끄면 다시 보임
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, XX=window.NexaSheetX, S=window.NexaSheet.S; X.selectCell(0,0); XX.filterToggle(); const b=await until(()=>document.querySelector('#fltLay .flt[data-fc="0"]'), 3000); if(!b) return 'no button'; b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const pop=document.querySelector('.fltPop'); const lab=[...pop.querySelectorAll('label')].find(l=>l.textContent.includes('부산')); lab.querySelector('input').checked=false; pop.querySelector('[data-fa="ok"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80)); const c=S.deck.sheets[0].cells, rowOf=Object.keys(c).find(k=>/^A\d+$/.test(k) && (typeof c[k]==='object'?c[k].v:c[k])==='부산'), r=+rowOf.slice(1)-1; const hidden=!document.querySelector(`#grid th[data-row="${r}"]`), notSaved=!S.deck.sheets[0].hiddenRows, on=document.querySelector('#fltLay .flt.on'); XX.filterToggle(); await new Promise(r2=>setTimeout(r2,80)); const back=!!document.querySelector(`#grid th[data-row="${r}"]`) && !document.querySelector('#fltLay .flt'); return hidden && notSaved && on && back ? true : JSON.stringify({hidden,notSaved,on:!!on,back})

steps.name: 드롭다운 - F2:F5 에 목록(대기,진행,완료) → 칸 옆 ▼ 로 '진행' 고르기, 목록에 없는 값은 모서리 표시, 저장 형식 validations
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, XX=window.NexaSheetX, S=window.NexaSheet.S; window.prompt=()=>'대기,진행,완료'; X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:5,r2:4,c2:5}); XX.dvCreate(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80)); X.selectCell(2,5); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const b=document.querySelector('#dvBtn'); const vis=!b.hidden; b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); const it=await until(()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('.menu button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='진행'), 3000); if(!it) return 'no item'; it.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const sh=S.deck.sheets[0], v=(k)=>sh.cells[k]&&typeof sh.cells[k]==='object'?sh.cells[k].v:sh.cells[k]; window.NexaSheet.setInput(sh,'F4','없는값'); X.renderAll(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const marks=document.querySelectorAll('#dvLay i').length; return vis && v('F3')==='진행' && marks===1 && JSON.stringify(sh.validations)==='[{"range":"F2:F5","list":["대기","진행","완료"]}]' ? true : JSON.stringify({vis,F3:v('F3'),marks,dv:sh.validations})

steps.name: 조건부 서식 - B2:B5 '보다 큼 700' 빨강 채움 → 해당 칸 2개만 칠함, 지우면 사라짐
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, XX=window.NexaSheetX, S=window.NexaSheet.S; X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:1,r2:4,c2:1}); XX.condDialog(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const dlg=document.querySelector('.cfDlg'); dlg.querySelector('[data-k="type"]').value='gt'; dlg.querySelector('[data-k="v1"]').value='700'; dlg.querySelector('[data-k="st"]').value='0'; dlg.querySelector('[data-fa="ok"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,120)); const red=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#grid td[data-c="1"]')].filter(td=>/255, 199, 206/.test(getComputedStyle(td).backgroundColor)).length; const n1=red(), saved=JSON.stringify(S.deck.sheets[0].conds); X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:1,r2:4,c2:1}); XX.condClear(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n2=red(); return n1===2 && n2===0 && saved.includes('"type":"gt"') ? true : JSON.stringify({n1,n2,saved})

steps.name: 함수 자동 완성 - =sumi 치면 SUMIF·SUMIFS 목록, Tab 으로 SUMIF( 넣고 인수 안내
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, ed=X.ED(); X.selectCell(9,0); X.startEdit('enter','=sumi'); ed.setSelectionRange(5,5); ed.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const box=document.querySelector('#acBox'); const items=[...box.querySelectorAll('[data-ac]')].map(x=>x.dataset.ac); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Tab',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const v=ed.value, sig=box.querySelector('.sig') && box.querySelector('.sig').textContent; ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true})); return items.join()==='SUMIF,SUMIFS' && v==='=SUMIF(' && sig && sig.includes('범위, 조건') ? true : JSON.stringify({items,v,sig})

steps.name: 동적 배열 - H2 에 =SORT(B2:B5) → 아래 칸으로 넘쳐 보인다(H3·H5 는 sp)
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, ed=X.ED(), N=window.NexaSheet; const put=async(r,c,t)=>{ X.selectCell(r,c); ed.focus(); ed.value=t; ed.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150)); }; const cells=()=>N.S.deck.sheets[0].cells, td=(r,c)=>document.querySelector(`td[data-r="${r}"][data-c="${c}"]`).textContent.trim(); await put(1,7,'=SORT(B2:B5)'); const c=cells(); return c.H2.v===300 && c.H3 && c.H3.sp==='H2' && c.H5.v===1200 && ['1200','1,200'].includes(td(4,7)) ? true : JSON.stringify({H2:c.H2,H3:c.H3,H5:c.H5,td:td(4,7)})

steps.name: 넘칠 자리에 값을 쓰면 #SPILL!, 지우면 다시 넘친다
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, ed=X.ED(), N=window.NexaSheet; const put=async(r,c,t)=>{ X.selectCell(r,c); ed.focus(); ed.value=t; ed.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150)); }; const cells=()=>N.S.deck.sheets[0].cells, td=(r,c)=>document.querySelector(`td[data-r="${r}"][data-c="${c}"]`).textContent.trim(); await put(3,7,'막음'); const a=cells().H2.v, h4=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cells().H4)); await put(3,7,''); const c=cells(); return a==='#SPILL!' && (h4==='막음' || (h4.v==='막음' && !h4.sp)) && c.H2.v===300 && c.H4 && c.H4.sp==='H2' && c.H4.v===800 ? true : JSON.stringify({a,h4,H2:c.H2,H4:c.H4})

steps.name: 요약·사용자 함수 - K2 에 =GROUPBY(A2:A5,B2:B5,SUM) → 지역 4줄 + Total 2,800 으로 넘쳐 보이고, 이름 정의 세후=LAMBDA(x,x*0.9) 로 =세후(1000) → 900
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, ed=X.ED(), N=window.NexaSheet; const put=async(r,c,t)=>{ X.selectCell(r,c); ed.focus(); ed.value=t; ed.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150)); }; const cells=()=>N.S.deck.sheets[0].cells, td=(r,c)=>document.querySelector(`td[data-r="${r}"][data-c="${c}"]`).textContent.trim(); X.mutate(()=>{ N.S.deck.names={세후:'=LAMBDA(x,x*0.9)'}; }); await put(1,10,'=GROUPBY(A2:A5,B2:B5,SUM)'); await put(8,10,'=세후(1000)'); const c=cells(); return c.K2.v==='광주' && c.K6 && c.K6.sp==='K2' && c.K6.v==='Total' && c.L6.v===2800 && td(5,10)==='Total' && ['2800','2,800'].includes(td(5,11)) && c.K9.v===900 && td(8,10)==='900' ? true : JSON.stringify({K2:c.K2,K6:c.K6,L6:c.L6,K9:c.K9,t:[td(5,10),td(5,11),td(8,10)]})
